cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Machines and electrical things at home; screens show simple pictures, never readable writing.

words.scene: Mia holding a smartphone, a video call with Grandma on its screen.
more: She lost her cell phone yesterday.
她昨天把手机弄丢了。
I want to use my cell phone.
我想用我的手机。

words.scene: Dad talking on his mobile phone as he walks in the street.
more: My mobile is ringing!
我的手机在响！
Tom's mobile has a picture of Max.
Tom 的手机上有 Max 的照片。

words.scene: Lily on the sofa holding a phone to her ear, smiling.
more: The phone rings in the kitchen.
厨房里的电话响了。
Can I use your phone?
我可以用你的电话吗？

words.scene: an old red home telephone with a curly cord on a little table in the hall.
more: The telephone is on the wall.
电话挂在墙上。
Dad answers the telephone.
爸爸接电话。

words.scene: Sam taking a picture with a small silver digital camera.
more: The digital camera is small.
这台数码相机很小。
I take photos with my digital camera.
我用我的数码相机拍照。

words.scene: One black camera with a big round lens standing on a table, its flash on top and a strap lying beside it.
more: Can I take a photo with your camera?
我可以用你的照相机拍照吗？
The camera is in my bag.
照相机在我的包里。

words.sz: Lily 用她的笔记本电脑。
words.scene: an open laptop on a kitchen table, Lily typing on it.
more: Dad works on his laptop.
爸爸在笔记本电脑上工作。
The laptop is heavy.
这台笔记本电脑很重。

words.en: I play games on my PC.
words.sz: 我在我的个人电脑上玩游戏。
words.scene: a desktop PC with a big monitor, keyboard and mouse on a desk.
more: The PC is on the desk.
个人电脑在桌子上。
Mum uses the PC for work.
妈妈用个人电脑工作。
The screen of the computer is bright.
电脑的屏幕很亮。
Lily types her homework on the computer.
Lily 在电脑上打字做作业。

words.scene: Grandpa listening to an old radio in the kitchen.
more: The radio is very loud.
收音机声音很大。
We hear music on the radio.
我们在收音机里听到音乐。

words.scene: the family on the sofa watching a big television, a cartoon on the screen.
more: Turn off the television, please.
请关掉电视。
Tom likes cartoons on television.
Tom 喜欢看电视里的动画片。

words.sz: Tom 看一个有趣的视频。
words.scene: Tom and Lily watching a funny dog video on a tablet.
more: Mum records a birthday video.
妈妈录了一个生日视频。
We share the video with Grandma.
我们和奶奶分享这个视频。

words.scene: an electric kettle with a plug and a cable, steam coming out.
more: Dad has an electric car.
爸爸有一辆电动车。
We use the electric fan in summer.
我们夏天用电动风扇。

words.en: We need electricity for the lights.
words.scene: a plug going into a wall socket, small yellow sparks of light around it.
more: Electricity makes the lamp work.
电让台灯工作。
Be careful with electricity!
小心用电！

words.scene: Mum kneeling in front of a white front-loading washing machine in the kitchen, putting dirty clothes in through its round glass door, Max sitting beside her watching.
more: The washing machine is full.
洗衣机满了。
Dad puts clothes in the washing machine.
爸爸把衣服放进洗衣机。

words.en: Lily puts the CD in its case.
words.sz: Lily 把光盘放进盒子里。
words.scene: Lily holding one shiny round silver disc with a hole in the middle up to the light, rainbow colours on it, its thin square plastic case open in her other hand.
more: Do you like this CD?
你喜欢这张光盘吗？
Sam has a new music CD.
Sam 有一张新的音乐光盘。

words.en: Dad listens to music on the CD player.
words.sz: 爸爸用 CD 播放机听音乐。
words.scene: One silver CD player on a wooden shelf with its round tray open and a shiny disc in it, two small loudspeakers beside it.
more: The CD player is broken.
CD 播放机坏了。
We need a new CD player.
我们需要一个新的 CD 播放机。

words.en: The clock in the kitchen is loud.
more: Mum looks at the clock on the wall.
妈妈看看墙上的钟。
The clock says it is time for bed.
钟显示该睡觉了。

words.en: Mum cooks dinner on the cooker.
more: Be careful of the hot cooker.
小心烫的炉灶。
Grandma cleans the cooker every week.
奶奶每周都清洁炉灶。

words.sz: Lily 找到了她最喜欢的 DVD。
more: This DVD is very funny.
这张 DVD 很有趣。
Tom wants to watch the DVD again.
Tom 想再看一次 DVD。

words.sz: 爸爸用 DVD 播放机。
more: The new DVD player works well.
新的 DVD 播放机工作正常。
Please turn on the DVD player.
请打开 DVD 播放机。

words.en: Lily gets some juice from the fridge.
words.sz: Lily 从冰箱里拿了一些果汁。
more: The fridge is very cold.
冰箱很冷。
Max looks at the open fridge.
Max 看着打开的冰箱。

words.en: Dad turns off the gas after cooking.
words.sz: 爸爸做完饭后关掉燃气。
more: We need more gas for the fire.
我们需要更多燃气来生火。
The blue fire comes from the gas.
蓝色的火来自燃气。

words.en: The heating keeps the house warm.
more: It is cold, so we turn on the heating.
天气冷，所以我们开暖气。
Lily feels hot because of the heating.
因为暖气，Lily 觉得热。

words.en: Mum turns on the lamp at night.
more: The lamp gives a soft light.
这盏灯发出柔和的光。
Tom reads under his small lamp.
Tom 在他的小台灯下读书。

words.en: The light in the bedroom is bright.
senses: Lily has a light blue dress.
more: Turn off the light before you sleep.
睡觉前关灯。
The sun gives us natural light.
太阳给我们自然光。

words.en: Mum takes the cake out of the oven.
words.sz: 妈妈把蛋糕从烤箱里拿出来。
more: The oven is very hot inside.
烤箱里面很烫。
We bake bread in the oven on Sundays.
我们星期天在烤箱里烤面包。
